purpose: Test the released SAM2 three-mask decoder, ranked by its existing predicted IoU, for the single automatic Lean initial prompt.
scope: First automatically detected frame and archived YOLO box, identical source image and initial prompt schedule. Baseline replays the existing single-mask box and early-FPN-point procedure exactly. Candidate uses the author SAM2 three-mask decoder and its own highest-predicted-IoU selection for each of those same two prompt stages, recomputes early-FPN points from the candidate provisional mask, and restores normal behavior before any video propagation. Original no-object handling and existing binary mask decision remain unchanged.
constraints: No new detection, re-detection, confidence gate, threshold, learned weights, extra frame, future image or annotation in inference. This may change point coordinates and the initial mask but cannot be assumed to repair an unrelated wrong box or create a valid polyp from a labeled-empty frame. SAM2 predicted IoU ranking is not oracle mask quality.
verification: First perform two independent label-free seq3 prompt replays. Baseline must exactly match previously archived provisional/refined masks and feature points. Instrument both candidate decoder calls to verify exactly three alternatives and author argmax predicted-IoU selection; identical outputs across independent processes, unchanged model parameters, restored original method and no extra image. Once verified, produce initial-frame candidate outputs for all 21 videos. After all images are processed, independently score both masks against ground truth; report present Dice, labeled-empty false alarms, changes, and unavailable reference cases. Choose whether to do a full-video study only on fixed criteria and without per-sequence inference-time method switching.
limitations: This is an inspected and non-independent cohort, GT is used only for offline score reporting, detector training split is unknown, and labels may be incomplete. A same-frame mask improvement does not prove improvement over video propagation.
